assumptions_made: Used first word of document as label for simplicity since the dataset doesn't have explicit labels
Selected one document per label as query for fair comparison
Limited dataset to 1000 documents due to compute constraints
Used a simple token-based approach for building document-term matrices
Assumed that TF-IDF weighting would provide better discrimination than raw counts in this context
Used cosine similarity for nearest neighbor search as standard approach
Used precision at 5 and mean reciprocal rank as evaluation metrics as specified
Implemented a basic synthetic fallback when network fetch fails

results.hypothesis: Test whether TF-IDF weighting improves nearest-neighbour retrieval precision over raw term counts.
results.author: coder-agent
results.success_criteria: TF-IDF improves precision at 5 by at least 0.05 over raw counts.
results.notes: TF-IDF improved precision at 5 by 0.000. Raw: 1.000, TF-IDF: 1.000. Does not meet success criteria.
